TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Enable Gravship Tweaks
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: This entire section is disabled by default for compatibility sake mostly, some gravship related tweaks function regardless of if they've been changed (any changing a radius for example) so this allows them all to be skipped over without any potential for conflicts if you prefer another gravship tweak mod.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Disable Gravship Cooldown
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If enabled, this tweak will disable the cooldown after moving the gravship before you are allowed to launch again.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Gravship Hull Conduits
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If enabled, this tweak will add conduit functionality to the gravship hull at no extra cost.\n\nNote: Does not require 'Enable Gravship Tweaks' to be active.

TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.label: Gravship Landing Outcomes
TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.description: Tweaks specific to the gravship landing outcome events. If all are disabled this may cause issues when it tries to run one.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Disable Landing Outcome: Grav Nausea
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If enabled, this tweak will disable landing event that gives pawns grav nausea.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Disable Landing Outcome: Minor Gravship Crash
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If enabled, this tweak will disable landing event where the gravship has a minor crash damaging parts of it.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Disable Landing Outcome: Overheated Grav Engine
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If enabled, this tweak will disable landing event that excessively increases the cooldown before next launch.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Disable Landing Outcome: Thruster Breakdown
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If enabled, this tweak will disable landing event that causes an immediate breakdown in thrusters.

TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.label: Gravship Engine
TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.description: Tweaks specific to the gravship engine.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Powered GravEngine
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If enabled, makes the GravEngine capable of providing some power (350 by default, can be changed after a restart in the general power tweaks section).\n\nNote: Does not require 'Enable Gravship Tweaks' to be active.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Substructure Support
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The total supported substructure for the ship provided by the engine itself.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Substructure Radius
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The substructure footprint radius for the ship provided by the engine itself.

TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.label: Gravship Field Extender
TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.description: Tweaks specific to the gravship field extender.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Max Extenders
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The maximum allowed extenders on one ship.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Substructure Support
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The total supported substructure for the ship provided by field extenders.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Substructure Radius
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The substructure footprint radius for the ship provided by field extenders.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Max Distance From Engine
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The maximum distance from the grav engine that field extenders can be placed.

TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.label: Gravship Chemfuel Tanks
TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.description: Tweaks specific to the gravship chemfuel tanks.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Chemfuel Tank Capacity
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The total capacity of the standard chemfuel tank.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Large Chemfuel Tank Capacity
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The total capacity of the large chemfuel tank.

TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.label: Gravship Thrusters
TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.description: Tweaks specific to the gravship thrusters.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Small Thruster Range
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The travel range added to the gravship from a single small thruster.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Large Thruster Range
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The travel range added to the gravship from a single large thruster.

TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.label: Gravship Shield Generator
TweaksGalore.TweakSubSectionDef.description: Tweaks specific to the gravship shield generator.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Radius
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The radius which the shield covers.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Intercepts Ground Projectiles
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: Whether or not the shield intercepts ground based projectiles (standard ranged weapons).

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Intercepts Air Projectiles
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: Whether or not the shield intercepts air based projectiles (mortars and similar).

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Hitpoints
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The total hitpoints a full shield can take in damage.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Recharge Ticks
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The total ticks (60 ticks per second) before the shield recharges.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Full Restores
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If hitpoints should instantly be full when the shield recharges.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Start Full
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: If hitpoints should instantly be full when the shield initially charges.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Shield Duration Ticks
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The total ticks (60 ticks per second) the shield is active for when activated.
